title: A Signal for the Static Anew
author: Mara Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Brightwater, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
